page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a title block at the top. Below the text, at the right, is the catchword "V. Re-". The right side of the scan shows the outer edge of the neighbouring page (the continuation of the treatise), which is not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.head: JOHANNIS MELLET. Theosophiae Naturalis praecognita.
main_text.p: Theosophia naturalis est disciplina de Deo, ex Lumine naturae, cognoscendo & colendo.
I. Disciplina cum sit, erit methodi-cum homogeneorum praeceptorum Systema.
II. Theosophiae naturalis videnda est Praecognitio & Recognitio ; Illa explicat Theosophiae principium ; Haec ipsum corpus & Systema.
III. Principium Theosophiae naturalis est duplex, Experientia & Recta-Ratio.
IV. Experientia est congruum & universale sensuum testimonium, seu est constans omnium rerum in mundo existen-tium consensus, hanc qui negat, se animal esse negat.

page.notes: The right-hand strip (partly cut off by the scan edge) belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Catchword "V. Re-" is printed at the foot right. Hyphens at line ends (methodi-cum, Recta-Ratio, existen-tium) are printed hyphens and are kept. The accent on "cum" in thesis I is faint and uncertain; written as "cum".
